findings.problem: The example has no conjugated verb, only the infinitive verte, so it does not meet the rule that the example conjugates a verb.
findings.fix: example.es: Fue una sorpresa verte aquí. example.en: It was a surprise to see you here.

back.example: What a surprise to see you here!

note: The original exclamation is perfectly natural Spanish and fails only on the conjugated-verb rule.
